every_position_composed.reason: Both sites use identical camera paths and staging across frames 1 through 9, keeping the 3D subjects well-framed to the right of the text cards.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D factory metaphors—such as the log press in frame 3 and anchor caliper in frame 6—to illustrate Straitjacket's workflow.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: In frames 1 through 9, the second site's darker floor grid creates better contrast with the dark machinery and glowing progress lines, whereas the first site's brighter grey floor washes out the scene's depth.

type_and_layout.reason: While typography and card layouts are identical across frames 1 to 9, the second site's darker background integrates more seamlessly with the dark UI cards.

overall.reason: Both sites share identical layouts, copy, and 3D models, but the second site's darker environment and subtle grid provide superior contrast and visual cohesion for the 3D pipeline.
